title: Boostify
shortDescription: Free Chrome extension that boosts audio and video on any HTML5 site — designed and shipped by me.
description: Manifest V3 extension for volume up to 600%, playback speed, video enhancement, EQ, vocal/music split, Quiet Ads on YouTube, and per-site control — 100% client-side, no accounts, no tracking.
overview: Boostify is a free Chrome extension that enhances audio and video on any site with HTML5 media. A master ON/OFF toggle controls all processing — when off, nothing runs. Boost volume up to 600% via Web Audio API, set playback speed from 0.25× to 4×, and tune video clarity, brightness, contrast, and saturation with a live before/after preview in the popup. Presets cover 4K, Movie, and Game modes, plus a custom preset you can save and pin. The equalizer adds bass, mid, treble, and echo; audio modes include 8D, Voice Focus, and mono. Vocal and music sliders use mid/side separation on stereo sources — useful for karaoke and podcasts, not AI stem separation. Quiet Ads lowers or mutes ad audio on YouTube (volume only — not an ad blocker). Picture-in-Picture, auto-pause when you leave a tab, per-domain allow/block lists, customizable keyboard shortcuts, and dark/light themes round out the experience. All settings stay in chrome.storage.local on the device — no server, no analytics, no sign-in. Version 1.7.7.
process: Problem framing for YouTube, streaming, and learning use cases
Popup UX with master toggle, presets, and before/after preview
Web Audio pipeline: gain, EQ, mid/side split, echo, 8D, mono
Video filter system with SVG unsharp mask for clarity
Per-site persistence, site list, and keyboard shortcuts
Privacy-first architecture — strict CSP, no network requests
results: Live extension v1.7.7 — load unpacked or Chrome Web Store (coming soon)
Volume boost to 600% with graceful DRM/CORS fallbacks
Video presets plus custom save-and-pin workflow
Quiet Ads for YouTube ad audio without blocking ads
100% free — local-only storage, no accounts or tracking
